# Excel Export

The Project Analytics Dashboard lets you export all dashboard data to a professionally styled Excel file with a single click. The export contains four worksheets covering every aspect of your project data.

<a id="how-to-export"></a>

## How to Export

1. Click the **spreadsheet icon** in the dashboard header.
2. A styled `.xlsx` file downloads immediately to your browser's default download location.

tip

The export respects your active filters. Apply filters first to export only the data you need.

warning

The `xlsxwriter` Python library must be installed on your Odoo server. Install it with `pip install xlsxwriter`. If it is missing, the export button displays a friendly error message.

---


<a id="worksheet-1-dashboard-overview"></a>

## Worksheet 1: Dashboard Overview

The first sheet provides a high-level summary with the same metrics shown in the stat cards.

![Excel Overview Sheet](data:image/webp;base64,)

Included fields: Total Projects, Total Tasks, Total Employees, Completed Tasks, Pending Tasks, Overdue Tasks, Completion Percentage, and Productivity Score.

---


<a id="worksheet-2-project-progress"></a>

## Worksheet 2: Project Progress

A per-project breakdown showing completion status for every project in your portfolio.

![Excel Progress Sheet](data:image/webp;base64,)

Columns include: Project Name, Total Tasks, Completed Tasks, Pending Tasks, and Progress Percentage.

---


<a id="worksheet-3-recent-tasks"></a>

## Worksheet 3: Recent Tasks

The most recent tasks exported in a tabular format for quick review or sharing.

![Excel Tasks Sheet](data:image/webp;base64,)

Columns include: Task Name, Project, Stage, and Status.

---


<a id="worksheet-4-departments"></a>

## Worksheet 4: Departments

Department-level data showing employee distribution across your organization.

![Excel Departments Sheet](data:image/webp;base64,)

Columns include: Department Name and Employee Count.

---


<a id="styling"></a>

## Styling

All worksheets include professional formatting with:

- Bold headers with coloured backgrounds
- Auto-sized column widths
- Consistent font and alignment
- Styled for direct use in presentations or reports
